sentiment.rationale: The document reports exceptional Q4 and full-year results with record revenue and strong profit growth, and management expresses high confidence in future growth, including an ambition to become a US$100 billion company within two years. However, there is no explicit formal guidance raise beyond this ambition, and the document acknowledges external headwinds such as supply shortages and rising component costs. The strong operational momentum and confident forward language support a positive score, but the lack of a formal guidance raise and the presence of stated risks temper the score to +0.30.

summary.revenue: Q4 revenue of US$21.6 billion, up 27% year-on-year; full-year revenue of US$83.1 billion, up 20% year-on-year.
summary.eps: Q4 basic EPS of 4.32 US cents, up from 0.73 US cents year-on-year; full-year basic EPS of 15.63 US cents, up from 11.30 US cents.
summary.guidance: Management expressed ambition to become a US$100 billion company within the next two years, and expects continued growth driven by AI-related revenue and Hybrid AI strategy.
summary.margin: Q4 gross margin flat at 16.4% year-on-year; full-year gross margin declined 0.7 points to 15.4%. Q4 operating margin improved to 4.1% from 2.0% year-on-year; full-year operating margin improved to 3.9% from 3.1%.
